offence_note: Historical sexual exploitation of a young person
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal the appellant’s sentence and vary his sentence, but only to the extent that: (i) the SOIRA order shall apply for a period of 20 years rather than for life; and (ii) the order that the appellant pay a victim fine surcharge of $200 is set aside.
